items.a: DevFest.cz 2026 takes place on 30 October 2026 at Uhelný Mlýn — a converted industrial mill in Libčice nad Vltavou, just outside Prague — fully in person. Capacity is strictly capped to keep the day focused, so grab a ticket early.

items.q: How do I get to the venue?
items.a: Uhelný Mlýn is at Areál Šroubáren 860, 252 66 Libčice nad Vltavou, just north of Prague. Take a train toward Kralupy nad Vltavou from Praha-Bubny (or Praha-Podbaba) and get off at Libčice nad Vltavou — roughly a 30-minute ride, with trains about every 30 minutes. From the station it is a short walk (about 0.7 km) to the venue.
It's run by GUG.cz, z.s. — a Czech developer community. DevFest.cz is a volunteer-driven community event.

items.q: What language are the talks in?

items.a: Tickets are sold in three waves — Early Bird, Regular, and Lazy Bird — with the price rising each wave. Early Bird tickets start from 2 099 Kč (VAT included). Live pricing for the current wave is always shown in the Tickets section on the home page.
Each wave offers two options: Individual (personal purchase) and Company funded (priced for employer-reimbursed purchases). Both grant full access to the conference.
Live availability and pricing are shown in the Tickets section on the home page. Tickets are released in waves — the earlier you grab one, the better the price.

items.q: Can I get an invoice for my company?
items.a: Tickets are sold through ti.to, which emails a receipt as soon as you buy. For specific company billing details, contact devfest@gug.cz.
Yes — talk recordings are published after the conference. We'll announce them via the newsletter and our social channels.

items.q: How can I become a speaker?
items.a: The Call for Proposals is now closed — submissions are no longer accepted for DevFest.cz 2026. The lineup will be announced soon. For any speaker enquiries, reach us at devfest-speakers@gug.cz.

items.q: How can my company become a partner?
items.a: See the Partners page for what we offer, or write to filip.goszler@gug.cz.
Drop your email in the form on the home page and follow us on social media — ticket drops and program news land there first.
